post.description: Listing payments into or out of an address, finding when it first or last moved funds, or paging through its full history. Use `get_transaction` for one transaction's full inputs and outputs.

address.description: Bitcoin mainnet address: base58 P2PKH (`1...`) or P2SH (`3...`), bech32 segwit v0 (`bc1q...`) or bech32m taproot (`bc1p...`); or a `https://mempool.space/address/<address>` URL. Checksums are verified; testnet addresses are rejected. Pattern: ^(?:[13][1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{25,34}|[bB][cC]1[02-9ac-hj-np-zAC-HJ-NP-Z]{8,87}|https?://(?:www\.)?mempool\.space/\S*)$.

after_txid.description: Return the confirmed transactions older than this one; pass the previous page's `next_after_txid`. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$.

200.description:
Transaction history of one Bitcoin mainnet address, newest first, as compact rows: txid, confirmation (height/time), fee, vsize, input/output counts and what the transaction did to this address (received, sent and net satoshis). The first page holds unconfirmed transactions followed by confirmed ones (50 rows in total); later pages hold 50 older confirmed transactions after `after_txid`. Source: mempool.space `GET /api/address/:address/txs`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `transactions` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block_height` | number | Height of the confirming block; null while unconfirmed. |
| `block_time` | number | Confirming block timestamp, unix seconds; null while unconfirmed. |
| `confirmed` | boolean | Whether the transaction is in a block. |
| `fee_sats` | number | Fee paid by the transaction in satoshis. |
| `input_count` | number |  |
| `net_btc` | string | received minus sent, in BTC (negative for net outflow). |
| `net_sats` | number | received minus sent, in satoshis. |
| `output_count` | number |  |
| `received_sats` | number | Value paid to this address by the transaction in satoshis. |
| `sent_sats` | number | Value of this address's outputs the transaction spent in satoshis. |
| `txid` | string |  |
| `vsize` | number | Virtual size in vbytes. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) of one Bitcoin mainnet address, newest first (unconfirmed, then by block height): txid, output index, value and confirmation. `total_count` and `total_sats` cover every UTXO even when `limit` trims the list. mempool.space lists at most 500 UTXOs per address and refuses larger sets (`upstream_error`). An address that has never appeared in a transaction is `not_found`; one that has spent everything returns an empty list. Source: mempool.space `GET /api/address/:address/utxo`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `utxos` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block_height` | number | Height of the confirming block; null while unconfirmed. |
| `block_time` | number | Confirming block timestamp, unix seconds; null while unconfirmed. |
| `confirmed` | boolean | Whether the transaction is in a block. |
| `txid` | string |  |
| `value_btc` | string | UTXO value in BTC, an exact 8-decimal string (e.g. `50.00000000`). |
| `value_sats` | number | UTXO value in satoshis. |
| `vout` | number | Output index. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Current Bitcoin fee estimates from mempool.space in sat/vB (fastest = next block, half hour, hour, economy, minimum relay) plus the projected next blocks built from the mempool (tx count, vsize, total fees, median and min/max fee rate; up to 8). Live values that change every few seconds. Source: mempool.space `GET /api/v1/fees/recommended` and `/api/v1/fees/mempool-blocks`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_url` | string | The mempool.space API request this result was shaped from. |
| `economy_fee` | number | sat/vB for low-priority transactions. |
| `fastest_fee` | number | sat/vB to target the next block. |
| `half_hour_fee` | number | sat/vB to target ~3 blocks. |
| `hour_fee` | number | sat/vB to target ~6 blocks. |
| `minimum_fee` | number | Minimum relay fee rate, sat/vB. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix milliseconds when this program read mempool.space. |
| `projected_block_count` | number | Projected blocks the mempool currently fills. |
| `projected_blocks` | object[] | The next projected blocks, nearest first, at most 8. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

hash.description: Block hash (64 hex characters) or a `https://mempool.space/block/<hash or height>` URL. Send `hash` or `height`, not both. Pattern: ^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{64}|https?://(?:www\.)?mempool\.space/\S*)$.

height.description:
Block height (0 = genesis). Send `hash` or `height`, not both.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 10000000.

post.description: Checking whether a payment confirmed and how deeply, who paid whom and how much, or the fee a transaction paid. Use `transaction_outspends` to see which outputs were later spent and by which transaction.

txid.description: Transaction id (64 hex characters) or a `https://mempool.space/tx/<txid>` URL. Bitcoin mainnet only. Pattern: ^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{64}|https?://(?:www\.)?mempool\.space/\S*)$.

200.description:
One Bitcoin mainnet transaction by txid: confirmation status, block height/hash/time, confirmations against the current tip, size/weight/vsize, fee and fee rate, RBF signaling, every input with the previous output it spends (address, value, script type) and every output (address, value, script type; script hex for address-less outputs such as OP_RETURN). Amounts in satoshis plus exact BTC strings. Inputs and outputs are listed up to 200 each (`inputs_truncated`/`outputs_truncated`); counts and totals always cover all of them. Source: mempool.space `GET /api/tx/:txid` and `/api/blocks/tip/height`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_url` | string | The mempool.space API request this result was shaped from. |
| `block_hash` | string | Hash of the confirming block; null while unconfirmed. |
| `block_height` | number | Height of the confirming block; null while unconfirmed. |
| `block_time` | number | Confirming block timestamp, unix seconds; null while unconfirmed. |
| `confirmations` | number | Blocks since (and including) the confirming block, from the tip height read in the same call; null while unconfirmed. |
| `confirmed` | boolean | Whether the transaction is in a block. |
| `fee_btc` | string | Fee in BTC, an exact 8-decimal string (e.g. `50.00000000`). |
| `fee_rate_sat_vb` | number | Fee rate in sat/vB, rounded to 2 decimals. |
| `fee_sats` | number | Fee (0 for coinbase transactions) in satoshis. |
| `input_count` | number |  |
| `inputs` | object[] | Inputs in order, at most 200. |
| `inputs_truncated` | boolean | True when the transaction has more than 200 inputs. |
| `is_coinbase` | boolean | Whether this is a block's coinbase transaction. |
| `locktime` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix milliseconds when this program read mempool.space. |
| `output_count` | number |  |
| `outputs` | object[] | Outputs in order, at most 200. |
| `outputs_truncated` | boolean | True when the transaction has more than 200 outputs. |
| `rbf_signaling` | boolean | Whether any input signals replace-by-fee (BIP-125 sequence below 0xfffffffe). |
| `size` | number | Serialized size in bytes. |
| `tip_height` | number | Chain tip height read in the same call. |
| `total_input_btc` | string | Sum of the spent previous outputs in BTC; null for coinbase transactions. |
| `total_input_sats` | number | Sum of the spent previous outputs; null for coinbase transactions. |
| `total_output_btc` | string | Sum of all outputs in BTC, an exact 8-decimal string (e.g. `50.00000000`). |
| `total_output_sats` | number | Sum of all outputs in satoshis. |
| `txid` | string | Transaction id (lowercase hex). |
| `url` | string | The transaction's mempool.space page. |
| `version` | number |  |
| `vsize` | number | Virtual size in vbytes (weight / 4, rounded up). |
| `weight` | number | Weight units (BIP-141). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_url` | string | The mempool.space API request this result was shaped from. |
| `fee_bands` | object[] | Fixed bands, highest fee rate first; each band covers min_fee_rate <= rate < max_fee_rate. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix milliseconds when this program read mempool.space. |
| `total_fee_btc` | string | Fees offered by all waiting transactions in BTC, an exact 8-decimal string (e.g. `50.00000000`). |
| `total_fee_sats` | number | Fees offered by all waiting transactions in satoshis. |
| `tx_count` | number | Unconfirmed transactions. |

200.description:
Spending status of each output of one Bitcoin mainnet transaction: for every output its value and address, whether it has been spent, and the spending transaction id, input index and confirmation (height/time). Includes counts of spent/unspent outputs and the unspent value. Paged 200 outputs at a time from `start_index`. Source: mempool.space `GET /api/tx/:txid` and `/api/tx/:txid/outspends`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `outputs` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |

| `address` | string | Receiving address; null for address-less scripts. |
| `index` | number | Output position (vout). |
| `script_type` | string |  |
| `spending_block_height` | number | Height of the block confirming the spend; null when unspent or the spend is unconfirmed. |
| `spending_block_time` | number | Timestamp (unix seconds) of that block; null when unspent or the spend is unconfirmed. |
| `spending_confirmed` | boolean | Whether the spending transaction is confirmed; null when unspent. |
| `spending_txid` | string | Transaction that spent the output; null when unspent. |
| `spending_vin` | number | Input index of the spending transaction; null when unspent. |
| `spent` | boolean |  |
| `value_btc` | string | Output value in BTC, an exact 8-decimal string (e.g. `50.00000000`). |
| `value_sats` | number | Output value in satoshis. |
